<ic>That the territory of Karsk be allocated to an Imperial Nation.<br><br>Proposed by Mitwold, Seconded by Karov.</ic> 
{{CaptionedImage|file=Karskregions.png|title=A war-torn land|caption=Regions of Karsk|align=right|width=400}}
===Overview===
* The territory of [[Karsk]] was reconquered by Imperial forces during the Autumn of 378YE.
===Date===
* Winter 378YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The territory of Karsk is now part of the nation of Varushka.
* It is noted that the territory is still not secure - the [[Thule]] still control three of the seven regions.
